name: GroqCloud supported-models page, re-read 2026-10-17 (production table: gpt-oss public, Llama sales-gated)
notes: Fetched 2026-10-17. Preview adds qwen/qwen3.8-27b at $0.80/$4.00 and vendor 450 t/s, and openai/gpt-oss-safeguard-20b at $0.075/$0.30. Vendor tok/s figures are list attributes, not a third-party measurement. groq.com/pricing itself no longer renders a rate card.
